title: Staged Outer-to-Inner Layer Optimization with Quarter-Wave Seed
scientific_hypothesis: Optimizing outermost 6 layers first, then progressively including inner layers, will stabilize band-edge transitions and prevent the oscillatory collapse observed in iterations 3-5 where full-stack simultaneous optimization caused score regression from 0.9251 to 0.67-0.73 range.
design_principle: Sequential optimization reduces configuration space complexity; outer layers dominate edge-band behavior while inner layers control stopband center. Staging prevents gradient interference between spectral regions.
design_variables: layer thicknesses (optimized in 3 stages: outermost 6, then middle 8, then inner 8)
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack initialization provides physically motivated starting point for local optimization
Outer layers have stronger influence on band-edge transition sharpness
expected_advantages: Prevents oscillatory collapse seen in prior full-stack optimization
Better control over visible-NIR transition region
known_risks: Staged optimization may converge to local optimum different from simultaneous optimization
Additional computational rounds required for staging
execution_request_english: Design a 22-layer alternating TiO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate at 45 degrees incidence. Initialize all layers at quarter-wave optical thickness centered at 550nm (TiO2 approximately 57nm, SiO2 approximately 96nm based on typical indices). Set thickness bounds 30-250nm for all layers. Execute staged gradient optimization: first optimize only outermost 6 layers (layers 1-3 and 20-22) while holding inner 16 layers fixed at quarter-wave values; second stage optimize layers 1-10 and 13-22 holding layers 11-12 fixed; final stage optimize all 22 layers. Target observable: maximize weighted sum of mean reflectance in 450-650nm band and mean transmittance in 700-1000nm band. Incident medium is air. Evaluate both s and p polarization states and report unpolarized average. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 450-650 nm, 700-1000 nm. soft objectives: high reflectance in 450-650 nm; high transmittance in 700-1000 nm; minimized crosstalk between bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: transmittance in 450-650 nm; reflectance in 700-1000 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 24 layers.
revision_reason: Addresses oscillatory collapse from iterations 3-5 by implementing staged outer-to-inner optimization per feedback directive. Changes from prior route_03: adds explicit 3-stage optimization sequence instead of single-stage full-stack optimization.
